Cedrus deodara (Roxb.) G. Don
Large evergreen tree, up to 40-50 m tall, crown pyramidal or spreading. Bark dark grey, deeply fissured into rectangular blocks. 
Leaves needle-like, rigid, dark green to glaucous, (2.5-)3-4.5(-5) cm long, clustered in whorls of 20-30 on short shoots. 
Cones solitary or in pairs, barrel-shaped, 7-12 x 5-9 cm, erect, maturing in second year.
